comments.author: ortusdux
comments.story: Amazon’s electric Rivian vans have delivered 150M packages
comments.why: Comprehensive walkthrough of Rivian delivery van.
comments.text: Doug DeMuro did a rather comprehensive walkthrough as well. [VIDEO] Annoyingly, they didn't fix my main UX gripe with delivery vehicles, which is that they use the same lights for the hazards and turn signals. It's quite common for the right half of a stopped van to be obscured, which makes it impossible to tell the difference between "hazards on, delivering a package" and "left blinker on, about to cut in front of you".
